about: S-admin-posts - the admin's marketplace posts. Captured LIVE against a scratch backend (own port, throwaway encrypted DB, seeded by seed-scratch.mjs with deterministic post ids Ax0000000001.. - squat, nov, half, cali, autumn, fast, mob, squat2, author-off): `node scripts/pulse-shot.mjs --package S-admin-posts --live --api http://localhost:3722 --serve . --port 5222`. Nothing is recorded into the freeze and no write is ever fired (the sheets are opened and filled, never confirmed). Account A = admin@.
